Each cell is a percentile of that country’s own history since 2006 (2008-09 and 2020 excluded; 2021 also excluded for growth rows; PMI history is shorter, see tooltips). PMIs and Sentiment are levels, other rows YoY %; nominal retail sales are deflated by CPI; Housing, Retail and IP use a 3-month average. CPI is scored by distance from the central bank’s target (2%; Brazil 3%). * = stale: freshest published reading lags more than 4 months (quarterly: 6). Sources: Bloomberg, S&P Global.
